most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 shares the target's most distinctive cluster: a mysterious teacher-figure of miraculous origin who wanders from place to place bringing the foundations of ordered communal life, performs miracles including literally walking upon a great lake, apparently perishes/vanishes into water only to reappear, and is prophesied to return in a time of trouble.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 4 is barely a narrative at all—a personified mountain, a salt flat, mummies, and a village—with no creator figure, no making or destroying of humankind, no teaching of civilization, and no departure or promised return.
